title: Choose the visual world for DOT ANNE HOME LODGE
question: The roll assigned The Estate Plan. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll. Your brief's colours (forest green, ivory, gold, charcoal) and serif + sans pairing hold in every option.

options.label: The Estate Plan
options.lineage: Tema's numbered town plan and surveyors' estate plot sheets
options.thesis: The site is a plan sheet for one plot: No. 473, Golf Estate, and every section brings you closer to its gate.
options.viewport: Full-bleed photo of the real courtyard; headline and booking actions set in a plan-sheet title block holding plot number, Plus Code, phone and a live 'front desk open' clock.
options.risk: If the plan language is overdone it reads as a surveyor's site, not a warm lodge; photos must carry the warmth.

raised.raise: Directions become a numbered course: Kpone Barrier, BOST Road, Golf Estate, No. 473, each control paired with a description row.
The light is the state: a live Tema clock shows the front desk open at any hour, made for late arrivals.
Changes are visible before they happen: the booking form shows the exact WhatsApp message as you type it.
Total palette commitment: rules, icons, map and buttons in the four inks only, no stray greys.
Gold stays on hairlines, the route and the primary action, never on text blocks.
One strict grid with sheet coordinates; nothing breaks the column lines.

regions.label: title block: headline, CTAs, plot 473, clock
info strip: 24/7, Golf Estate, 4.2 rating, WhatsApp

options.label: The Lodge Stationery
options.lineage: boutique hotel letterpress stationery: letterhead, key card, compliments slip
options.thesis: The website as the lodge's printed welcome suite, handed to you at the desk.
options.viewport: Courtyard photo beside a large letterhead card carrying the headline and the two actions.
options.risk: This is where most hotel sites in this register land; familiar and safe, less memorable.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: The lodge as the final control on a purple course.
options.viewport: Terrain map with the course to the lodge in purple.
options.risk: Guests do not read orienteering maps; it costs warmth.
options.case: Same family as the roll but loses on audience identification.
options.kept: Numbered directions with paired description rows.

options.label: Akari Workshop
options.thesis: Rooms as glowing paper volumes in a dim room.
options.viewport: Lit paper volumes hanging at different heights.
options.risk: Foreign to Tema and to the lodge's own look.
options.kept: The light is the state: front desk shown open, live.

options.label: Algorave Floor
options.viewport: A code buffer as the stage.
options.risk: Wrong audience and wrong mood entirely.
options.kept: Show the change before it lands: live WhatsApp message preview.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The lodge as numbered teletext pages.

options.label: Mondo Spread
options.risk: Destroys warmth and the brief's palette.
options.kept: Total commitment to a fixed ink set.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud
options.risk: Too cold and abstract for a lodge.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A classic boutique-hotel site: big photo hero, room cards, amenity icons, map, footer.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline over a full-bleed photo with two buttons.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other lodge site in Accra.
